{{Quote|Don't worry, your highness... I'll tell ''everyone'' you put up a ''bold'' fight, once my name goes down in ''legend'' as "the pirate who ''kidnapped'' a princess".|The Weequay pirate, to Leia Organa|<ref name="Leia's Trust" />}}
This '''unidentified Weequay pirate''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a band of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] aboard a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]].

==History==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], this [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] made a deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[Skirmish aboard the Redemption|attack]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], so that [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Silam Dunerz]] could earn the trust of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. However, the Weequay pirate exceeded the terms of his agreement when he boarded the Rebel [[Starship/Legends|ship]] with his men.<ref name="Leia's Trust" />
